articles.summary: Sensata's Brake Force sensor directly measures clamping force within the brake caliper, providing the real-time feedback required for precise electromechanical brake (EMB) control. Supports improved braking performance, consistency, and safety through high-accuracy force measurement and closed-loop control at each wheel. Enables OEMs to accelerate adoption of brake-by-wire architectures designed for electrification, software-defined vehicles, and advanced driver assistance systems. Sensata Technologies (NYSE: ST), today announced its brake force sensors are now enabling electromechanical braking (EMB) systems in leading electric vehicles. This milestone marks a significant step in the transition from traditional hydraulic braking to fully electric, brake-by-wire systems, as vehicle OEMs increasingly adopt architectures designed for electrification, autonomy, and software-defined control.
